patch_description: Redesigns the broadcast planner into separate graph preparation, exact Steiner solving, multi-start greedy fallback, pruning, and topology emission stages. Small and medium destination sets use an exact directed-Steiner dynamic program. Large fan-out sets use several deterministic construction policies—including nearest, farthest, source-distance, shared-branch, and seeded shuffle variants—and retain the cheapest pruned union of network links. This reduces redundant cloud transfers while preserving the existing topology interface.
